newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares inch higher, AMS surges.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares inch higher, AMS surges.

text.p: 1315 GMT - Austrian shares end marginally higher in line with buoyant international bourses, but off session highs. Traders unconvinced ATX index has finally left the 1,100 mark behind, and say fall back to 1,085 cannot be ruled out.
* ATX index up 1.54 points, or 0.14 percent, at 1,102.39.
* December ATX future up 1.4 points at 1,106.4.
* 10 ATX shares up, 10 down, one unchanged.
* Top gainer microchip maker AMS, up 5.68 percent at 800 schillings, boosted by gains in U.S. semiconductor shares and belief worst is behind for the firm's loss-making subsidiaries.
* Leading decliner Flughafen, down two percent at 486. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12 253
